rounding: round monetary fills and commissions to nearest cent before ledger mutation; compare integer cents

session_start.offline_value: carried simulator cash/equity entering the session within the governed split
session_start.live_paper_value: first authenticated pre-open IBKR paper-account NetLiquidation snapshot at or before 09:30, frozen for the session
session_start.account_scope: the explicitly configured paper account only

owned_trade_ledger.principle: D49 and the daily stop use Protocol101's own reconciled fill-and-commission ledger, not a lagging broker realized-PnL aggregate
owned_trade_ledger.partial_fill: reserve actual filled quantity and cash immediately; one-contract policy blocks another entry while any quantity is open or pending
owned_trade_ledger.cancel_or_reject: release only the unfilled reservation after broker acknowledgement
owned_trade_ledger.late_commission: retain a conservative preregistered commission reserve until exact commission arrives; reconcile cents without rewriting prior decision records
owned_trade_ledger.realized_session_pnl_cents: sum exact net closed-trade PnL cents for this session

d48.prospective_entry_cost_cents: t+1 executable ask cents*100 + round-trip-fee reserve cents

d49.soft_close_effect: permanent WAIT for new entries for the rest of the session; existing position may still HOLD/EXIT
d49.reason: $1.00 option premium times 100 plus $3 fee reserve

daily_stop.effect: no new entries for the session; existing position remains under lifecycle and protective exit rules

restart_recovery.required_result: bit-exact reconstruction of open quantity, cash reservations, realized_session_pnl_cents, D48 mask, D49 mask, soft-close state, and daily-stop state
restart_recovery.mismatch: block new entries and route to operator reconciliation; never choose the more permissive state

policy_comparison: each candidate and comparator owns a separate causal ledger; masks are recomputed from that policy's prior realized trades rather than shared after divergence
